name: @shotlist/tutorial
description: Remotion project that renders the shotlist tutorial video and the README images

scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render Tutorial ../media/tutorial.mp4
scripts.stills: npm run assets && remotion still Hero ../media/hero.png && remotion still Timeline ../media/timeline.png && remotion still BeforeAfter ../media/before-after.png --frame=232
scripts.media: npm run render && npm run gif && npm run stills
